core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hawah corresponds to the Arabic form حواء and is glossed in this record as “First woman, created from Adam.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hawah corresponds to the Arabic form حواء (Qur'anic proper name; حَوَّاء (Ḥawwāʾ)). Its core sense is eve, the first woman. Hawah is Arabic حَوَّاء (Ḥawwāʾ), the name of Eve, the first woman. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave هوآه (non-standard) and glossed the name 'First woman, created from Adam's rib', which is a narrative gloss rather than a lexical meaning. Same name as hawa, hawwa and hawwaa.
